response.summary: Nothing in this record points to a non-cardiac cause; the visit did not explore gastrointestinal, musculoskeletal or pulmonary causes, so a non-cardiac cause is not ruled out. The documented features (exertional, pressure-like pain in a patient with diabetes, elevated blood pressure and a family history of heart disease) led the clinician to suspect unstable angina, and the normal resting EKG reported does not settle the question either way.
